description: Source code defining the TestInstance class used for executing and managing test suites on platforms within the Twister testing framework.

classes.name: TestInstance
classes.description: Class representing the execution of a specific TestSuite on a platform, managing test execution, configuration, and result handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestInstance with a test suite, platform, and output directory, setting up paths and test cases.

methods.name: add_filter
methods.description: Adds a filter reason and type to the test instance, marking it as filtered.

methods.name: init_cases
methods.description: Initializes test cases from the associated test suite.

methods.name: _get_run_id
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a cached unique run ID for the test instance.

methods.name: add_missing_case_status
methods.description: Sets the status and reason for test cases that are not yet completed.

methods.name: __getstate__
methods.description: Prepares the object state for pickling.

methods.name: __setstate__
methods.description: Restores the object state from pickling.

methods.name: __lt__
methods.description: Defines less-than comparison based on the test instance's name.

methods.name: set_case_status_by_name
methods.description: Sets the status and reason for a specific test case identified by name.

methods.name: add_testcase
methods.description: Creates and adds a new test case to the test instance.

methods.name: get_case_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a test case by name.

methods.name: get_case_or_create
methods.description: Retrieves a test case by name or creates it if it does not exist.

methods.name: testsuite_runnable
methods.description: Determines if a test suite is runnable based on harness and fixtures.

methods.name: setup_handler
methods.description: Configures the appropriate handler for test execution based on environment and platform.

methods.name: check_runnable
methods.description: Checks if the test suite is ready to run considering platform, filters, and environment.

methods.name: create_overlay
methods.description: Creates a configuration overlay for the test environment, optionally enabling coverage, sanitizers, etc.

methods.name: calculate_sizes
methods.description: Calculates RAM/ROM sizes of the test binary after build.

methods.name: get_elf_file
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the ELF binary for the test.

methods.name: get_buildlog_file
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the build log file.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TestInstance object.
